facts_original: The treadmill arrived yesterday
Plugged in and nothing happened: screen stays black, belt never moves
It has never worked
facts_translated: 跑步机昨天到货
插电后毫无反应：屏幕不亮，跑带也不动
从来没启动过

groups.evidence: I plugged it in and nothing happened: the screen stays black and the belt never moves. It has never worked.

facts_original: Used the rower for three months without problems.
Last week the motor started grinding and now it stops after two minutes.
Support answered but told the customer to repair it themselves.
facts_translated: 划船机正常用了三个月。
上周电机开始异响，现在两分钟就停。
客服回复了，却让客户自己维修。

groups.evidence: Last week the motor started grinding and now it stops after two minutes.
they answered but told me to repair it myself

facts_original: Sent six emails and used chat twice
Only automatic replies saying the team is busy
No human answered the question
facts_translated: 发了六封邮件、用了两次在线客服
只收到“团队繁忙”的自动回复
没有真人回答问题

groups.evidence: I have sent six emails and used the chat twice. All I get are automatic replies saying the team is busy. Nobody has actually answered my question.

facts_original: Customer asked support how to reset the console after a software update.
Support replied after three weeks with the correct steps.
The answer was fine, but the wait was far too long.
facts_translated: 顾客在软件更新后询问客服如何重置控制台。
客服三周后回复了正确步骤。
答复没问题，但等待时间太长。

groups.evidence: They finally replied after three weeks with the correct steps.

facts_original: Ordered two weeks ago
No tracking number in confirmation email
Order page still says preparing
Cannot see where parcel is
facts_translated: 两周前下单
确认邮件里没有物流单号
订单页一直显示备货中
查不到包裹在哪

groups.l1: 物流状态无法跟踪/感知
groups.evidence: There is no tracking number in the confirmation email, and the order page still says 'preparing'.

facts_original: Customer returned the machine
Company confirmed by email that it arrived at their warehouse
Three weeks later the refund still has not been paid
facts_translated: Customer returned the machine
Company confirmed by email that it arrived at their warehouse
Three weeks later the refund still has not arrived

groups.evidence: Three weeks later the refund still has not been paid.

facts_original: Parcel was shipped on time
It has been sitting in a sorting centre for three weeks
Tracking updates but the parcel does not move
facts_translated: 包裹按时发出
在分拣中心躺了三（周）
物流信息会更新，但就是不往前走

translation_issues.detail: The translation omits the unit 'weeks' after 'three' ('三').

groups.evidence: it has been sitting in a sorting centre for three weeks

facts_original: Asked to return the vibration plate within the 30-day window
Support refused to issue a return label and said the customer should ship it at their own cost
facts_translated: 在30天窗口内申请退回振动板
客服拒绝提供退货标签，并要求客户自费寄回

groups.evidence: Support replied and refused to issue a return label, saying I should ship it at my own cost.

facts_original: Deck incline advertised as 15%, received machine is 10% at most
Frame arrived cracked
Unit cannot be used
facts_translated: 商品页宣传坡度 15%，收到的机器最多 10%
机架到货时已有裂纹
整台机器无法使用

groups.evidence: the frame arrived cracked and the unit cannot be used
The product page says the deck has a 15% incline. The machine I received is 10% at most.

facts_original: Delivery was quick
Assembly took twenty minutes
The rower feels solid
Very happy with it
facts_translated: 发货快
组装二十分钟
划船机很稳
非常满意

groups.evidence: Delivery was quick, assembly took twenty minutes, and the rower feels solid.
